concept: Doing a small routine the same way each time, and noticing how that helps
source_inspiration: original content, informed by Tokkatsu-style routine-building principles — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character builds a small daily routine and notices it makes a hard task easier over time
exercise.reflection_prompt: What changed for the character once the routine became normal?
exercise.practice: Student picks one small routine they could try doing the same way each day this week

assessment.success_marker: student names a specific, realistic small routine
